{{CSGO}}: 2015-02-01 |disbanded=2021-01-11 }} '''Team Envy''' (formerly known as '''Team EnVyUs''', often abbreviated to '''Envy''', '''EnVy''' or '''nV''') was an [[:category:United States|American]] esports organization founded in 2007 who used to be mainly known for their competitive ''Call of Duty'' background. Their original lineups were referred to as the ''"Boys in Blue"''. ==Timeline== {{tabs dynamic |name1=2015 |name2=2016 |name3=2017 |name4=2018 |name5=2019 |name6=2020 |name7=2021 |This=7 |content1= * February 1st - '''Team EnVyUs''' acquire [[Team LDLC.com]]'s roster. {{cite web|url=https://www.hltv.org/news/14144/ldlc-lose-csgo-team|date=2015-02-01|title=LDLC lose CS:GO team|author=Luís "[[MIRAA]]" Mira|publisher=[[HLTV]]}} * July 20th - '''Team EnVyUs''' and [[Titan]] swap players, [[kennyS]] and [[apEX]] join the team, while [[shox]] and [[SmithZz]] leave. {{cite web|url=https://www.hltv.org/news/15529-titan-envyus-swap-players|date=2015-07-20|title=Titan, EnVyUs swap players|author=Luís "[[MIRAA]]" Mira|publisher=[[HLTV]]}} * November 1st - '''Team EnVyUs''' win [[DreamHack/2015/Cluj-Napoca|DreamHack Open Cluj-Napoca 2015]] after beating [[Natus Vincere]] 2-0 in the finals. |content2= * January 10th - [[Maniac]] is officially announced as the new coach of '''Team EnVyUs'''. {{cite web|url=https://www.hltv.org/news/16758-maniac-joins-envyus-as-coach|date=2016-01-10|title=Maniac joins EnVyUs as coach|author=Luís "[[MIRAA]]" Mira|publisher=[[HLTV]]}} * March 8th - [[DEVIL]] is acquired from [[Team LDLC.com White]] to replace [[kioShiMa]] in the active roster. The organization will honor [[kioShiMa]]'s contract until a transfer to another organization is agreed upon, or he returns to the starting lineup {{cite web|url=https://teamenvyus.com/blogs/news/92217793-devil-replaces-kioshima-in-envyus-cs-go-lineup|date=2016-03-08|title=DEVIL replaces kioShiMa in EnVyUs CS:GO lineup|publisher='''Team EnVyUs'''}}.
